Verification ran, but the run is **not done**. The acceptance criterion passes; failure scenario FS1 from the design has no evidence at all.

| Item | Result | Confidence |
|---|---|---|
| **AC1**: `bash tests/test.sh` exits 0 (lowercases, collapses non-alphanumerics to `-`, trims) | pass | Verified (multi-source) |
| **FS1**: CDN serves the old slug's page for up to 24 h after a title rename, so new links 404 | manual-unverified | Unverified |

**AC1 evidence** (saved in `.feature-flow/url-slugs/evidence/`):
- **Tests:** `bash tests/test.sh` exited 0 with all 3 checks ok (`hello-world`, `a-b`, `release-2-0`).
- **Direct runs of the script:** `bash src/slugify.sh` on 5 more titles exited 0 every time, e.g. `MiXeD CaSe 123!!!` → `mixed-case-123`.
- **Syntax check:** `bash -n` on both scripts exited 0. `shellcheck` isn't installed, so no full lint ran.

**Regression risk: Low.** The change is a new standalone script plus its test, and nothing else in the repo uses it. There was no plan or risk register for this run, so this is based on the changed files alone.

**Accented titles:** the design says accented letters are lost, but here `Café résumé` came out as `café-résumé`, with the accents kept. How `sed` handles these characters depends on the system's locale settings, so production output may differ. A slug with accented characters also isn't strictly URL-safe. This is outside AC1 and doesn't block anything.

> Verification found evidence gaps — this run is NOT done:
> - FS1: CDN serves the old slug for up to 24 h after a title rename, so new-slug links 404 — Unverified — nothing in this repo can test it: there's no CDN, server or deploy config. It needs a check against the live site (e.g. `curl -I` on the new slug after a rename returns 200) or proof of a fix (CDN purge on rename, or a redirect from the old slug).
>
> To proceed: (a) address the gap and re-run `/feature-flow:ff-verify`, or (b) reply with an explicit waiver per gap — it will be recorded in `verify.md` as `Evidence gap accepted by user (<date>): <reason>` and the done transition re-attempted.

The report is at `.feature-flow/url-slugs/verify.md`. The verify phase stays `in_progress` until the gap is fixed or you waive it.
